name: Dissolve
description: Classic cross-fade.

name: Fade to Black
description: Fades out to black and back in on the next clip. Filmora: Fade / Dip to Black.

name: Dip to Color
description: Fades out to a solid color and back in on the next clip. Filmora: Dip to Color.

name: Dip to White
description: The clip fades to white and the next one appears out of the white. Filmora: Dip to White.

name: Dip to Gray
description: Dips to a soft dark gray and back, gentler than black. Filmora: Dip to Color.

name: Fast Zoom
description: The clip zooms in quickly right before the cut. Filmora: Fast Zoom.

name: Fast Wipe Left
description: Quick push to the left with motion blur. Filmora: Fast Wipe Left.

name: Slide
description: The new clip slides in from the right over the previous one. Filmora: Slide.

name: Blur Dissolve
description: Cross-fade while both clips blur and refocus. Filmora: Blur Dissolve.

name: Smooth Dissolve
description: Slow cross-fade with eased start and end. Filmora: Dissolve (ease).

name: Zoom Dissolve
description: Cross-fade with a gentle zoom on both clips. Filmora: Zoom Dissolve.

name: Luma Dissolve
description: The bright areas of the new clip appear first, then the fade completes. Filmora: Luma Dissolve.

name: Flash
description: A quick white flash right at the cut. Filmora: Flash.

name: Additive Dissolve
description: Both clips are added together so the image brightens at the crossing. Filmora: Additive Dissolve.

name: Flash Flicker
description: Two quick white flashes before switching clips. Filmora: Flash Flicker.

name: Light Leak Flash
description: A warm orange flash burns the image at the cut, like a light leak. Filmora: Light Leak Flash.

name: Burn / Exposure
description: The image overexposes until it burns out and reveals the next clip. Filmora: Burn / Exposure.

name: Wipe Left
description: The new clip enters with a soft edge from right to left. Filmora: Wipe Left.

name: Wipe Right
description: The new clip enters from left to right. Filmora: Wipe Right.

name: Wipe Up
description: The new clip rises from the bottom edge. Filmora: Wipe Up.

name: Wipe Down
description: The new clip comes down from the top edge. Filmora: Wipe Down.

name: Diagonal Wipe
description: Diagonal edge from the top-left corner. Filmora: Diagonal Wipe.

name: Diagonal Wipe Up
description: Diagonal edge from the bottom-left corner. Filmora: Diagonal Wipe.

name: Soft Wipe
description: Left-to-right wipe with a very wide feathered edge. Filmora: Soft Wipe.

name: Barn Door
description: Opens from a vertical centre line towards the sides. Filmora: Barn Door.

name: Barn Door Vertical
description: Opens from a horizontal centre line up and down. Filmora: Barn Door Vertical.

name: Blinds
description: Horizontal slats that open at the same time. Filmora: Blinds.

name: Vertical Blinds
description: Vertical slats that open at the same time. Filmora: Vertical Blinds.

name: Clock Wipe
description: Circular sweep like a clock hand, clockwise from 12. Filmora: Clock Wipe.

name: Wave Wipe
description: Left-to-right wipe with a wavy edge. Filmora: Wave Wipe.

name: Zigzag Wipe
description: Left-to-right wipe with a saw-tooth edge. Filmora: Zigzag Wipe.

name: Iris / Circle
description: A circle grows from the centre revealing the new clip. Filmora: Iris / Circle.

name: Iris Out
description: The new clip enters from the edges while the old one closes into a central circle. Filmora: Iris Out.

name: Box In
description: A rectangle with the frame's proportions grows from the centre. Filmora: Box In.

name: Diamond
description: A diamond grows from the centre. Filmora: Diamond.

name: Checkerboard
description: Checkerboard squares fill in two alternating passes. Filmora: Checkerboard.

name: Diamond Grid
description: A grid of diamonds grows until it covers the frame. Filmora: Diamond Grid.

name: Heart
description: A heart grows from the centre revealing the new clip. Filmora: Heart.

name: Star
description: A five-pointed star grows from the centre. Filmora: Star.

name: Spiral
description: A wipe that sweeps in a spiral from the centre outwards. Filmora: Spiral.

name: Push Left
description: The new clip enters from the right and pushes the old one out to the left. Filmora: Push Left.

name: Push Right
description: The new clip enters from the left and pushes the old one out to the right. Filmora: Push Right.

name: Push Up
description: The new clip rises from the bottom and pushes the old one up. Filmora: Push Up.

name: Push Down
description: The new clip drops from the top and pushes the old one down. Filmora: Push Down.

name: Slide Right
description: The new clip slides in from the left over the old one, which darkens. Filmora: Slide Right.

name: Slide Down
description: The new clip slides down from the top and covers the old one. Filmora: Slide Down.

name: Slide Up
description: The new clip slides up from the bottom and covers the old one. Filmora: Slide Up.

name: Whip Pan Right
description: Fast camera pan to the right with motion blur. Filmora: Whip Pan / Fast Wipe Right.

name: Whip Pan Up
description: Fast vertical camera pan upwards with motion blur. Filmora: Whip Pan Up / Fast Wipe Up.

name: Whip Pan Down
description: Fast vertical camera pan downwards with motion blur. Filmora: Whip Pan Down / Fast Wipe Down.

name: Zoom In
description: The old clip zooms in while the new one grows from the centre to fill the frame. Filmora: Zoom In.

name: Zoom Out
description: The old clip shrinks away while the new one fades in zoomed and pulls back to full frame. Filmora: Zoom Out.

name: Cross Zoom
description: Fast zoom with radial blur that punches through the cut. Filmora: Cross Zoom.

name: Spin
description: The image spins half a turn and the new clip appears finishing the spin. Filmora: Spin.

name: Spin Zoom
description: Fast spin zooming in with blur; the new clip spins out while zooming back. Filmora: Spin Zoom.

name: Squeeze Horizontal
description: The old clip is squeezed to the left while the new one stretches in from the right. Filmora: Squeeze Horizontal.

name: Squeeze Vertical
description: The old clip is squeezed upwards while the new one stretches in from the bottom. Filmora: Squeeze Vertical.

name: Bounce
description: The new clip drops from the top and bounces before settling. Filmora: Bounce.

name: Glitch
description: Signal dropouts with RGB split, jumps and noise around the cut. Filmora: Glitch.

name: RGB Split
description: The red, green and blue channels drift apart and come back together on the new clip. Filmora: RGB Split.

name: Pixelate
description: The clip breaks into ever bigger blocks and resolves into the next one. Filmora: Pixelate.

name: Shake
description: The image shakes hard around the cut, with motion blur. Filmora: Shake.

name: Light Leak
description: A warm overexposed flare burns the image and reveals the new clip. Filmora: Light Leak.

name: Film Burn
description: The film burns in overexposed orange blotches that reveal the new clip. Filmora: Film Burn.

name: Ripple
description: The image ripples like water and dissolves into the new clip. Filmora: Ripple.

name: Mosaic
description: The new clip appears in tiles that flip in random order. Filmora: Mosaic.

name: Strobe
description: Intermittent white flashes alternate between both clips until settling on the new one. Filmora: Strobe.

name: VHS Rewind
description: VHS tape rewind: tracking lines, noise, smeared color and vertical jumps. Filmora: VHS Rewind.

name: Zoom Blur
description: A fast zoom that bulges and blurs towards the centre at the cut. Filmora: Zoom Blur.

name: Negative Flash
description: Colors invert with a flash right at the cut and return to normal. Filmora: Negative / Invert Flash.

name: Gaussian Blur
description: Blurs the whole clip evenly. Filmora equivalent: Gaussian Blur.

name: Box Blur
description: Uniform blur with a given radius (smooth approximation). Filmora equivalent: Basic Blur.

name: Background Blur
description: Bokeh: the centre stays sharp while the rest is blurred. Filmora equivalent: Background Blur / Bokeh.

name: Tilt Shift
description: A sharp horizontal band with blurred top and bottom, miniature look. Filmora equivalent: Tilt Shift.

name: Motion Blur
description: Directional streaks as if the camera moved. Filmora equivalent: Motion Blur / Directional Blur.

name: Radial Blur
description: Zoom streaks from the centre towards the edges. Filmora equivalent: Zoom Blur / Radial Blur.

name: Mosaic
description: Pixelates the clip into square blocks. Filmora equivalent: Mosaic / Pixelate.

name: Fisheye
description: Bulging wide-angle lens distortion. Filmora equivalent: Fisheye.

name: Ripple
description: Animated wavy distortion like a reflection on water. Filmora equivalent: Ripple / Wave.

name: Chromatic Aberration
description: Splits the red and blue channels apart. Filmora equivalent: Chromatic Aberration.

name: Glitch
description: Digital glitches: shifted RGB channels, noise and horizontal jumps. Filmora equivalent: Glitch / Digital Distortion.

name: Sketch
description: Turns the image into a pencil drawing with dark outlines on white. Filmora equivalent: Sketch / Edge.

name: Charcoal
description: Charcoal strokes on paper. Filmora equivalent: Charcoal.

name: Emboss
description: Grey relief, as if engraved in metal. Filmora equivalent: Emboss.

name: Sharpen
description: Unsharp mask that crisps details and edges. Filmora equivalent: Sharpen.

name: Mirror Horizontal
description: The left half is reflected onto the right. Filmora equivalent: Mirror (horizontal).

name: Mirror Vertical
description: The top half is reflected onto the bottom. Filmora equivalent: Mirror (vertical).

name: Mirror
description: Reflects one half of the frame onto the other (0 left→right, 1 right→left, 2 top→bottom, 3 bottom→top). Filmora equivalent: Mirror.

name: Flip Horizontal
description: Flips the clip left to right. Filmora equivalent: Flip Horizontal.

name: Flip Vertical
description: Flips the clip upside down. Filmora equivalent: Flip Vertical.

name: Kaleidoscope
description: Symmetric reflections in four quadrants, optionally repeated. Filmora equivalent: Kaleidoscope.

name: Camera Shake
description: Handheld camera shake for the whole clip. Filmora equivalent: Camera Shake.

name: Slow Zoom
description: Smooth, continuous zoom over the clip (Ken Burns). Filmora equivalent: Ken Burns / Slow Zoom.

name: Slow Pan
description: Slow sideways pan over the enlarged image. Filmora equivalent: Ken Burns (pan).

name: Zoom Pulse
description: Rhythmic zoom punches following a tempo. Filmora equivalent: Beat Zoom / Pulse.

name: VHS
description: VHS tape: bleeding colors, noise, scanlines and soft focus. Filmora equivalent: VHS.

name: Black & White
description: Monochrome with adjustable contrast. Filmora equivalent: Black & White.

name: Sepia
description: Brown tone of an old photograph. Filmora equivalent: Sepia.

name: Invert
description: Inverts the colors like a photographic negative. Filmora equivalent: Invert.

name: Posterize
description: Reduces the image to flat color bands. Filmora equivalent: Posterize.

name: Comic
description: Cartoon look: flat colors with dark outlines. Filmora equivalent: Comic / Cartoon.

name: 8-bit Pixel
description: Big pixels and a reduced palette, like an 8-bit video game. Filmora equivalent: 8-bit.

name: Old Film
description: Silent-movie film: sepia, flicker, frame jumps, dust and scratches. Filmora equivalent: Old Film.

name: Film Grain
description: Fine analog film grain. Filmora equivalent: Film Grain.

name: Dust & Scratches
description: Dust specks and vertical projector scratches. Filmora equivalent: Dust & Scratches.

name: Super 8
description: Home movie from the 70s: warm, faded, grainy, with vignette. Filmora equivalent: 8mm Film.

name: Vignette
description: Gently darkens the edges of the frame. Filmora equivalent: Vignette.

name: Light Leak
description: Warm orange glow sweeping across the frame. Filmora equivalent: Light Leak.

name: Strobe Flash
description: Rhythmic white flashes. Filmora equivalent: Strobe / Flash.

name: Neon
description: Glowing neon edges over a dark background. Filmora equivalent: Neon / Edge Glow.

name: Cinematic Bars
description: Black widescreen bars (2.39:1 at half the slider). Filmora equivalent: Cinematic Bars.

name: Polaroid Frame
description: White instant-photo border, wider at the bottom. Filmora equivalent: Polaroid Frame.

name: Inner Shadow
description: Soft shadow hugging the edges, like a recessed frame. Filmora equivalent: Inner Shadow.

name: Rounded Frame
description: Rounded corners over black, or with a white border. Filmora equivalent: Rounded Frame.

name: Teal & Orange
description: Teal shadows and orange skin tones, the blockbuster look.

name: Cinematic Cold
description: Thriller look: cold tones, strong contrast, less saturation.

name: Cinematic Warm
description: Warm golden cinematic look with deep blacks.

name: Moody
description: Dark and desaturated, with muted greenish shadows.

name: Faded Matte
description: Lifted blacks and dimmed whites, a matte film finish.

name: Bleach Bypass
description: Hard contrast and washed-out colors, like skip-bleach film.

name: Kodak Film
description: Kodak film emulation: warm, rich reds, soft shadows.

name: Fuji Film
description: Fuji film emulation: strong greens and cyans, neutral skin, cool shadows.

name: Vintage 70s
description: Warm yellows, olive greens and faded blacks of the 70s.

name: Retro 90s
description: 90s camcorder colors: magentas, cyans and high contrast.

name: Polaroid
description: Instant photo: creamy highlights, cyan shadows and pastel colors.

name: Soft Sepia
description: Delicate sepia tone of an old photograph.

name: B&W High Contrast
description: Black and white with pure blacks and bright whites.

name: B&W Soft
description: Black and white with soft greys and lifted blacks.

name: Noir
description: Film noir: hard, slightly cold monochrome with a vignette.

name: Selenium
description: Monochrome toned cool purple, like a selenium print.

name: Warm Sunset
description: Intense sunset oranges and pinks.

name: Golden Hour
description: Soft, bright golden light of the magic hour.

name: Blue Hour
description: Deep blue-hour blues and cold shadows.

name: Nordic
description: Scandinavian: cold, clean, bright and low saturation.

name: Ice
description: Icy cyan and bright whites.

name: Tropical Vivid
description: Turquoise cyan, intense greens and tanned skin.

name: Forest Green
description: Deep greens and moss, dark shadows.

name: Beach
description: Bright and airy: warm sand and turquoise sea.

name: Neon City
description: Urban neon night: magentas and cyans, deep blacks.

name: Soft Portrait
description: Warm, luminous skin and lower contrast.

name: Pastel
description: Soft washed colors, high key, pinkish shadows.

name: Vivid
description: Saturated colors and clean contrast that make the image pop.

name: Exposure
description: Exposure in stops, applied to linear light.

name: Brightness
description: Midtone brightness; black and white stay fixed.

name: Contrast
description: Contrast around mid grey.

name: Saturation
description: Color saturation (-100 = greyscale).

name: Vibrance
description: Saturation boost that protects already saturated colors.

name: White Balance
description: Color temperature (blue <-> amber) and tint (green <-> magenta).

name: Tint
description: Green <-> magenta balance.

name: Highlights & Shadows
description: Tone range adjustments: highlights, shadows, whites and blacks.

name: HSL
description: Hue, saturation and luminance per color band (8 bands).

name: Color Vignette
description: Darkens (negative) or brightens (positive) the frame edges.

name: Color Correction
description: Filmora-like Color panel: exposure, brightness, contrast, saturation, vibrance, white balance, tones and vignette.

name: Curves
description: RGB curves: points as "x/y x/y ..." in 0..1 per channel; channels first, then master.

name: LUT
description: Applies a 3D/1D .cube LUT to display-referred colors.

name: Fade In
description: Opacity rises from 0 to the clip's opacity.

name: Fade Out
description: Opacity falls from the clip's opacity to 0.

name: Zoom In
description: In: grows from small into place while fading in.

name: Zoom Out
description: Out: shrinks away from its place while fading out.

name: Zoom Out (In)
description: In: starts enlarged and settles down to its size while fading in.

name: Zoom In (Out)
description: Out: enlarges toward the viewer while fading out.

name: Slide In Left
description: In: slides in from the left edge.

name: Slide In Right
description: In: slides in from the right edge.

name: Slide In Up
description: In: slides in from the top edge.

name: Slide In Down
description: In: slides in from the bottom edge.

name: Slide Out Left
description: Out: slides out through the left edge.

name: Slide Out Right
description: Out: slides out through the right edge.

name: Slide Out Up
description: Out: slides out through the top edge.

name: Slide Out Down
description: Out: slides out through the bottom edge.

name: Spin In
description: In: spins in while growing from nothing.

name: Spin Out
description: Out: spins away while shrinking to nothing.

name: Bounce In
description: In: drops from above and bounces into place.

name: Bounce Out
description: Out: a small hop up, then falls off the bottom.

name: Boom
description: In: punchy zoom that overshoots and settles, with a short motion blur.

name: Pop In
description: In: pops up from nothing with a slight overshoot.

name: Drop In
description: In: falls in from above, slowing into place while fading in.

name: Ken Burns
description: Slow zoom and pan across the whole range.
